name: paprika3d
description: Three.js MCP server and Claude Code plugin: screenshot, play, test and profile the three.js, React Three Fiber and WebGL pages your coding agent builds. paprika3d runs them in headless Chrome on a paused, seeded clock and tells the agent what is on screen, what never appears, what each input changed and what a frame costs. With it: model files and a hosted library of models, textures and skies, models built in code, skills that build a page from a short brief, and publishing to paprika3d.app (preview, invite-only).
